name: EngineAI PM01
summary: PM01 is a 1.38 m, 40 kg open-platform humanoid with 24 DoF, sold for commercial, research and education use. It has a 320-degree waist rotation and is known for performing a front flip. EngineAI launched it at 88,000 yuan.
compute: x86 architecture with NVIDIA Jetson Orin modules.

price.configuration: Launch price, commercial and educational versions (promotional pricing through 2025-03-31)

highlights: EngineAI says PM01 performed the first humanoid front flip.
Peak torque density of 130 N·m/kg, per EngineAI.
caveats: The 88,000 yuan price was a launch promotion; reseller prices outside China are higher and vary.
Runtime and payload are not published officially.

sources.title: EngineAI releases PM01 humanoid robot for commercial, educational use
